items.source: Uses of OverridingClassLoader in org.springframework.instrument.classloading

items.translation: 可插拔的 ClassLoader 的简单实现。

items.source:
Support package for load time weaving based on class loaders,
as required by JPA providers (but not JPA-specific).
items.translation: 基于类加载器的支持包，用于在运行时进行织入（load time weaving），这是 JPA 提供者所必需的（但不特定于 JPA）。

items.source:
ClassLoader that can be used to load classes without bringing them
into the parent loader.
items.translation: 可用于加载类而无需将其引入父加载器的 ClassLoader。
